card.name: Ends of lab and drug-interaction terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word or the next word in drug-interaction text, such as the end of creatinine, warfarin or hyperuricemic. It also fires on words like effect or response after a drug or lab term.

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: Final piece of a lab or drug name such as creatinine, warfarin or hyperuricemic.

modes.label: Effect words
modes.description: Words like response, effect or high that follow a measured substance in an interaction statement.
modes.example: Oral estrogens may reduce the serum insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1)<< response>> to SKYTROFA.
